project_retention_days.description: Days to keep unmodified generated projects in output/ before the sweeper removes them. 0 keeps user work until explicitly deleted. SLIDESTUDIO_RETENTION_DAYS overrides this flag.

image_generate.description: Kill switch for the optional image-generate path; when false the editor never offers image generation even if a backend is configured.

mcp_register.description: Register the bundled slides-mcp server with the DSH 0.2.2-rc.5+ MCP manager (mcpManager.register) so DSH agents can call the SlideStudio tools over MCP. Hosts without mcpManager (rc.2) skip it with a warning.
